d: The A-Team crash lands in the backwoods, where they battle a band of crazed mountain men who are about to burn a man at the stake.
The A-Team helps a victimized farmer and his daughter deliver their produce to market, saving their farm from bankruptcy.
The A-Team rescues an Army General and his daughter from a band of guerilla terrorists.
The A-Team rescues a Texas heiress from an arranged marriage with her father's murderer.

st: The Beast From the Belly of the Boeing
d: Hannibal, Murdock, Face, and B.A. sneak aboard a 747 to rescue its passengers from hijackers.
A friend's funeral turns into a desperate fight for survival.
The A-Team go in search of a hidden diamond mine in the African jungle, while transporting a dangerous cargo of dynamite.

A chance meeting in a posh Los Angeles restaurant and a glimpse at a familiar face leads the A-Team on an adventure to save the life of the Vietnamese cook who helped them escape from the prisoner of war camp in Vietnam.
A mysterious call for help from Peck's former girlfriend sends the A-Team on a rescue mission to a desolate South American orphanage.
B.A befriends a lost little Mexican girl who leads him to a covert smuggling ring involved with illegally transporting aliens across the border.

st: When You Comin' Back, Range Rider? Pt 1
d: The A-Team heads west for an adventure tracking wild mustangs on the open range. Part 1 of 2.

st: When You Comin' Back, Range Rider? Pt 2

The A-Team rolls into the middle of a cab war to help save the Lone Star Cab Company from the Love Cab Company's reign of terror.
The A-Team helps a group of overworked and underpaid farm workers institute a union but their boss has other ideas.
The A-Team decide to help a family whose livelihood as fishermen seems doomed due to an extortionist.

The A-Team joins forces with three handicapped Vietnam veterans and Amanda Huston, to help keep one hungry and insidious Frank Gaines off their land and out of "Deadman," their town. Gaines, on the other hand, has plans to eliminate them altogether.
The demolition of an old warehouse becomes a war zone with the A-Team when a dangerous mob figure does not want old evidence excavated from the ruins.1
